items.title: A Trigger in Jammu and Kashmir: Militant Violence under Indian Central Rule
items.summary: In 2019, India made far-reaching changes to governance in Jammu and Kashmir, with the aim of quelling insurgency. Its policy has succeeded in some ways, but backfired in others. New Delhi will need to shift tack if it hopes to bring peace to the region.
